content.text: Disassembly, inspection and assembly of each component group have been indicated in the preceding chapter. This chapter deals with assembly of A43DE transmission.

Before assembly, make sure again that all component groups are assembled correctly. If something wrong is found in a certain component group during assembly, inspect and repair this group immediately.

items: The automatic transmission is composed of highly precision-finished parts, necessitating careful inspection before assembly because even a small nick could cause fluid leakage or affect performance.
Do not use adhesive cements on gaskets and similar parts.
Before assembling new clutch discs, soak them in automatic transmission fluid for at least two hours.
When assembling the transmission, be sure to use new gaskets and O-rings.
Apply automatic transmission fluid on sliding or rotating surfaces of the parts before assembly.
Dry all parts by blowing with compressed air. Never use shop rags.
Use petroleum jelly to keep the small parts in their places.
Be sure to install the thrust bearings and races in the correct direction and position.
